stage.text: This is SafeRoad. On the left, Musa, a member of the local vigilante group. On the right, Amara, a resident. The vigilantes always know what is happening first, but until now they had no way to reach everyone. SafeRoad gives them one.

voice_intro.text: Musa sees a fight at the market. He holds the mic and speaks Pidgin. Listen.

voice_after.text: SafeRoad, a multimodal AI agent, understood his voice, turned it into a structured alert, and is delivering it to every resident on the platform, instantly.

dropped.text: As you can see, it has dropped on Amara's side, in her own language, with Musa's name and the time. And if she taps Listen, the agent reads it out to her.

nopanic.text: No panic, no rumour. Every word from the vigilante reaches every resident, live.

clear.text: And when the coast is clear, Musa just says so.

cleared.text: The all-clear reaches Amara the same way. Everyone knows the moment it is over.

rumour.text: Now a friend forwards Amara a message: there is a fight at Ikorodu bus stop. Instead of guessing, she forwards it to her agent.

agent.text: No responder has reported that. So the agent says so honestly, and immediately asks the vigilante on duty. And if Amara cannot wait, she gets a button to call him directly.

musa.text: Amara's question arrives in Musa's chat in real time. He checks, and replies.

confirmed.text: And Amara gets his confirmation in real time, with his name and the time. No more misinformation.

outro.text: SafeRoad. A multimodal AI agent that lets a community speak in any language, and get verified information in real time.

live.text: SafeRoad is live and fully working right now, at the address on your screen. Log in with the demo accounts and try it yourself.
